home.seoTitle: Online appointment scheduling for your business
home.seoDescription: Clients book on their own, 24/7, with no double bookings. Hours, your country's holidays, notifications and sync with Google, Outlook and Apple. Try it free for 30 days.
home.title: Your clients book themselves. You do the work.
home.lead: Publish your hours, share them with a link or embed them on your website, and get every appointment instantly — no calls, no texts and no double bookings.
home.trialNote: No card needed to start. From $5/month.
home.highlightsTitle: Everything a schedule that works for you needs

highlights.title: Bookings around the clock
highlights.body: Clients pick a service, day and time from their phone, and confirm with a code sent to their email.

highlights.title: Never two at once
highlights.body: Each time slot is held the moment it's picked: even if two people book at the same time, only one gets it.

highlights.title: Your country's holidays
highlights.body: Block holidays for the United States, Canada, Mexico or any of about 200 countries, including their regions.

highlights.title: Your hours, your breaks
highlights.body: Shifts per day, lunch breaks, buffers between appointments, minimum notice and special days.

highlights.title: Sync your calendars
highlights.body: See your appointments in Google Calendar, Outlook or Apple Calendar and avoid clashes with your other plans.

highlights.title: Connect your AI
highlights.body: Ask Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini about your schedule and have it create or move appointments for you.

steps.title: Create your board
steps.body: Name, time zone and location. Choose your country and holidays are blocked automatically.

steps.title: Set hours and services
steps.body: Tell us when you work, your breaks and how long each service takes.

steps.title: Share your link
steps.body: Send it in a message, add it to your social profiles or embed it on your website with one line of code.

faq.q: Do I need a card for the trial?
faq.a: No. Create your account and use every feature for 30 days.

faq.q: What happens when the trial ends?
faq.a: We'll remind you before. If you don't pick a plan, your account becomes read-only: you don't lose your data.
Yes, anytime. The change is prorated on your next bill.

faq.seoDescription: Answers about bookings, holidays, calendar sync, languages, privacy and plans for My Appointment On Time.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: If you can't find your answer, write to us.

items.q: Do my clients need to create an account?
items.a: No. They enter their name and email and confirm with a 6-digit code sent to their email. They can use that same email to see their appointments later.

items.q: How do you prevent double bookings?
items.a: When someone picks a time, we hold it for 10 minutes while they confirm. The database refuses to save two appointments in the same seat at the same time, even if they arrive at the same moment.
Those of about 200 countries and their regions: public, bank, school and optional. You choose which ones block your schedule and can open on a specific holiday.

items.q: Does it work with Google Calendar, Outlook and Apple?
items.a: Yes. Your appointments show up in those calendars, and your events there block your schedule so nobody books over them.

items.q: Can I put it on my website?
items.a: Yes, with an iframe or one line of code. It works on WordPress, Wix, Squarespace or your own HTML.
English at myappointmentontime.online and Spanish at micitaentiempo.online. Your clients get emails in the language of the site where they book.

items.q: Can my clients see other people's appointments?
items.a: Never. Each client only sees their own appointments. Your team sees what their role allows.
On dedicated servers, with backups. You can export or delete your account at any time.
